text_to_image_prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Generate a NEW photorealistic clothing-library product photograph inspired by the described reference, not a copy of a screenshot. Pure opaque white #FFFFFF seamless background, bright soft frontal studio lighting, minimal soft contact shadow, crisp realistic fabric texture, true garment colors, no dramatic shadows. Portrait 2:3 canvas, complete centered objects with generous clear margin. Front-facing straight camera. No people, skin, head, neck, hands, legs, body, visible mannequin, stand, hanger, room, typography, logos, brand marks, watermarks, borders or collage. ONE coordinated CLOTHING-ONLY ensemble on an invisible ghost mannequin: Cream collared knit cardigan layered over white button-up shirt, relaxed ivory extra-wide trousers, white low-top sneakers. Natural hollow three-dimensional garment drape. Shoes and socks are part of this ensemble if described. EXCLUDE all detachable accessories: no ties, bags, jewelry, belts, glasses, headphones, hats, keychains, brooches, or hanging charms. No skin anywhere.
